requireOnlineBanner.cloudDescription: Internet is available, but the cloud/backend is unreachable. This section is temporarily disabled.
requireOnlineBanner.offlineDescription: This section requires an internet connection. It is disabled while you are offline. Reconnect to use it.
forgotPassword.sent.title: Check your inbox
forgotPassword.sent.descriptionEmail: If an account exists for that email address, we sent a password reset link. Check your email and follow the link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.sent.descriptionSms: If an account exists for that mobile number, we sent a password reset link by SMS. Open the message and follow the link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.sent.hintEmail: The link may take a few minutes to arrive. If you do not see it, check your spam folder.
forgotPassword.sent.hintSms: The link may take a few minutes to arrive. If you do not see it, check your spam folder or message filters.
